svg.text: Where the evidence URL comes from
Our URL revision stage against VILLAIN (AVerImaTeC shared task, 1st place). Boxes in orange are where a URL gets attached to a piece of evidence.
Ours: revise the URL of evidence we already have
start from the fact-checking article; one URL per statement, bound at extraction or recovered afterwards
Fact-checking article
cleaned text with every hyperlink kept in place as anchor [url]
Extraction (Gemma) → evidence statements
each statement carries a verbatim support_span; if a link sat on that sentence, it is attached here
AVerImaTeC val: 397 statements · 163 image · 13 metadata (no URL by design) · 221 need a link
Stage 1 · shortlist from the article's own hyperlinks (top 3)
rank by position relative to the support_span (in span › sentence › paragraph › section); token overlap breaks ties
excluded after unwrapping Wayback layers: the outlet itself · social embeds · archive mirrors · page furniture
verifier reads each candidate and records SUPPORTED / UNSUPPORTED / UNVERIFIABLE — shown, not deciding
Stage 2 · dated external-search candidates (≤3), only if stage 1 is empty
the URLs the old search stage already fetched; page date must not be later than the claim date (strict temporal policy)
same exclusions; same verifier record
Attach, or drop
attach the first admissible candidate, article link before external; keep the alternates and every verdict alongside
drop only when no candidate exists → 357 of 397 kept · 40 dropped · no attached link is the outlet or a social post
What this buys and what it does not
URL recall against annotators' URLs 0.13 → 0.18, precision 0.15 → 0.22 (val). EV2R scores statements, not links, so it barely moves
(R 0.724 → 0.697, P 0.619 → 0.639 after the 40 drops). The verifier passes about 1 in 5 links; most failures are unreadable pages,
so the verdict is kept as a record, not used as a gate. Every evidence keeps one URL, the others stay visible as candidates.
VILLAIN: retrieve first, write the evidence afterwards
start from the claim; evidence is generated from retrieved passages, sources kept as a pool
Claim (+ claim images)
no fact-checking article; the system must find its own sources
A1–A3 · three searches build a source pool
A1 web search on the claim text · A2 reverse image search per claim image · A3 image↔image and text→image
pages are chunked; every chunk keeps the URL of the page it came from
Retrieve and rerank passages
embed (mxbai) → top 100 chunks → cross-encoder rerank (mxbai-rerank-large) → top 10, with surrounding context
then a VLM writes three analyses: text vs claim, image vs text, agreement across sources
ranking says which passages are most relevant to the claim; nothing here says which passage supports which fact
A4 · generate question–answer pairs from the analyses
4 iterations × 5 QA, up to 20; three BM25-picked training examples as few-shots; passage URLs are visible to the model
the output schema has a url field per QA; in the run we reproduced it is empty on 50 of 50 QA
A5 · select 10 QA → verdict + justification
the 10 QA are the evidence submitted for EV2R
sources are saved once per claim as a pool (17 URLs in our sample), not per QA
What we can borrow, and the gap
Borrow: read the source page and rank passages against a target sentence, rather than ranking links by position.
Gap: "which source supports this evidence" is never decided or stored; a reranker's first place is relevance, not support.
Our stage 1 verifier is exactly that missing step, applied per candidate and kept with the evidence.

VILLAIN stages and parameters from the adapted reproduction (systems/villain.py, cfg: reranker_fetch_k 100, top 10, 4×5 QA ≤20, select 10); QA/url counts from smoke_campaign_mm_20260917_rog_cpu_r2. Ours: results/url_revision_aug30, 2026-09-23.
